summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli arrives in Qatar with a commanding 98-point lead over Max Verstappen, needing only a steady performance to edge closer to the Mercedes driver's first world championship. With tyre allocation capped at 27 laps per set, strategic pit-stop timing becomes critical, forcing teams to balance aggression with compound management on a track that punishes mistakes. Victory in Qatar would move Antonelli within touching distance of the title before the season finale in Abu Dhabi, potentially deciding the championship a race early.
